sources.used_for: COLOR_TRANSFER_SDR_VIDEO is SMPTE170M; COLOR_TRANSFER_LINEAR is numerical linear. Android enum values differ from ISO transfer identifiers.
SDR-video internal transfer maps principally to ISO transfer 1; linear maps to ISO 8. Actual SPS is still checked; constants are not output proof.
